app.name: RelocateMind
app.tagline: Discover your ideal country for relocation based on income, visa eligibility, and lifestyle goals.

homepage.hero_title: Find the Country That Fits Your Income & Passport
homepage.hero_subtitle: Get instant, deterministic match scores for 8+ digital nomad and residency programs worldwide.
homepage.deck_p1_desc: Cross-checks your passport restrictions, monthly revenue minimums, and accepted income structures (W2, freelance, dividends) against real immigration laws.
homepage.deck_p2_title: Local Living Cost vs. Income Ratio
homepage.deck_p2_desc: Calculates your real purchasing buffer in destination countries, factoring local average expenses, tax regimes, and quality of life.
homepage.deck_p3_desc: Get actionable, itemized instructions for document apostilling, tax registration numbers (NIF/NIE), bank account setup, and consulate interviews.
homepage.sample_1_desc: Mild climate, vibrant tech hub, and straightforward 3-month digital worker residency process.
homepage.sample_2_desc: Tax incentives under Beckham Law regime with Mediterranean lifestyle and high safety scores.
homepage.sample_3_desc: Eco-friendly haven offering 0% foreign income tax and low cost of living thresholds.
